verify.subject: Confirm your email for Rendetto
verify.body:
Hello {name},

open this link to confirm your email. Your trial starts with the confirmation:
{link}

The link is valid for 48 hours. If you did not sign up for Rendetto, do not open the link — an unconfirmed account is deleted after 7 days.

alreadyRegistered.subject: You already have a Rendetto account

reset.subject: New password for Rendetto
reset.body:
Hello {name},

to set a new password, open this link:
{link}

The link is valid for 1 hour and works once. If you did not ask for a new password, do nothing — your old one stays.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for Rendetto
changeEmail.body:
Hello {name},

to change your account's email to this address, open the link:
{link}

The link is valid for 24 hours. Until you open it, you sign in with the old email.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Rendetto account was deleted
accountDeleted.body:
Hello {name},

your account and all its projects have been deleted permanently.

If you did not ask for this, write to us at the address below.
